doc: Daily iron supplementation in children and adolescents 5–12 years of age in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在婴儿和幼儿贫血患病率40%或更高的地区，每日铁补充作为公共卫生干预措施推荐给5岁及以上学龄儿童，用于预防铁缺乏和贫血。
entries.source_doc: Daily iron supplementation in children and adolescents 5–12 years of age in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在疟疾流行区，婴儿和儿童的铁补充应与预防、诊断和治疗疟疾的公共卫生措施相结合。
entries.source_doc: Daily iron supplementation in children and adolescents 5–12 years of age in malaria-endemic areas
